topic.description: The word-order pattern the sentence practises.

tokens.description: Scrambled word/phrase tokens in natural mid-sentence casing, with no punctuation (the checker ignores it; the answer orders carry it for display).

answerOrders.description: Every accepted correct order, same shape as reorder exercises, written as the finished sentence: first word capitalised, commas and final full stop attached. The first one is the order shown as the answer.

alsoAccepted.description: Optional second tier: grammatical orders that are not the neutral order a teacher would expect (for example a place or an indefinite object before a time expression). They count as correct, and the feedback shows answerOrders[0] as the more usual order. Same format as answerOrders; an order may not appear in both lists.

translation_en.description: English translation, shown only after answering.
